page.notes: Title page. Ornament between "habita," and the imprint (a fleuron with a bracketed smiley and a hand/pointing mark) is not printed text and is omitted. Several words are in black letter or a different type: "DISPUTATIONVM THEOLOGICARVM" and "DVRATIONE" are in large capitals; "Respondente" and "ABRAHAMO ULRICO SERVISTA-" are italic/capitals as printed. Possible misreadings: "DVRATIONE" as printed reads "DVRATIONE" (the scan's "D" in DURATIONE is a large capital); "Mülhusini" with umlaut as shown. "clɔ Iɔc" uses the reversed-C form for D and M, rendered here with the printed form; the expected Roman numeral is MDCXIV, which the printer shows as "ANNO clɔ Iɔc XIV". Imprint publisher name "Wesselium" is read as printed, with the final letters of "Anhaltino" and "Servista-" uncertain and marked here as printed. Running line "Bremensi" carries no [?] as it is clear.
